facts.claim: 作者把整章编成清一色的「走进酒吧」笑话，每条只换角色与一句话机关，如白蚁问「这里有酒保吗」
facts.quote: A termite walks into a bar and says, ‘Is the bar tender here?’

facts.claim: 作者用北极熊的停顿作双关（pause／paws），由酒保一句追问点破
facts.quote: The barman says, ‘Why the big pause?’ The polar bear says, ‘I’m a polar bear.’

facts.claim: 作者把酒保写成固定捧哏，先示好再被顾客用酒价反将一军
facts.quote: ‘You know, we don’t get many gorillas in here.’ The gorilla says, ‘At nine quid a pint I’m not surprised.’

facts.claim: 作者用同一条「走进酒吧」句式连缀互不相关的角色，如只会点酒与拖把的骷髅
facts.quote: A skeleton walks into a bar and says, ‘I’ll have a pint of lager and a mop.’

facts.claim: 作者让酒保以「本店不供应」为由拒绝非人顾客，靠字面义与引申义错位出包袱
facts.quote: A ghost walks into a bar. The barman says, ‘Sorry, we don’t serve spirits.’

facts.claim: 作者把马的笑话写两次，第二次让马把招呼语‘Hey’听成干草（hay）
facts.quote: A horse walks into a bar. The barman says, ‘Hey.’ The horse says, ‘No thanks, a pint of lager please.’

facts.claim: 作者以时态双关收束全章：过去、现在、未来同处一室，所以‘气氛紧张’
facts.quote: Past, present and future walked into a bar. It was tense.

relations.relation: 作者全程不出面解说，把笑料按序摆出，双关（stool 兼指凳子与粪便）留给读者自己补出
relations.quote: A dung beetle walks into a bar and says, ‘Is this stool taken?’

relations.relation: 酒保以一句追问充当捧哏，把顾客的停顿从口吃转成身体特征
relations.quote: The barman says, ‘Why the big pause?’

relations.relation: 酒保先报价再搭话，顾客用同一价格反过来解释‘本店为何少见大猩猩’
relations.quote: ‘Sure,’ says the barman, pouring the pint. ‘Nine quid.’

numbers.meaning: 大猩猩那杯拉格的标价，也是它吐槽‘难怪这儿没大猩猩’的理由
numbers.quote: The gorilla says, ‘At nine quid a pint I’m not surprised.’

numbers.meaning: 醉汉连灌四杯双份威士忌后给出的理由：他身上只剩 20 便士
numbers.quote: The man downs his fourth double whisky and says, ‘20p.’

numbers.meaning: 三个阴谋论者一起走进酒吧，这句陈述本身就是‘不可能是巧合’的笑点
numbers.quote: Three conspiracy theorists walk into a bar. There’s no way that’s a coincidence.
